description: The figure presents four separate pie charts comparing the distribution of error (or response) categories for different language models (GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct). The GPT4-o chart contains 2 slices with percentage labels inside: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark red at about 83.3% (5) and an unlabeled light-orange slice at about 16.7% (1). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart contains 5 slices with labels and percentages inside and no legend: “Misinformation” in orange at about 38.4% (33), “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at about 22.1% (19), “Ethical Advice” in light blue at about 16.3% (14), “Clarification” in pale yellow at about 14.0% (12), and “Safety” in red at about 9.3% (8). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices with labels and percentages inside: “Lack of Knowledge” in light orange at about 75.0% (3) and “Clarification” in dark red at about 25.0% (1). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart contains 2 equal slices with labels inside: “Lack of Knowledge” in light orange at about 50.0% (2) and “Misinformation” in dark red at about 50.0% (2). Across all charts, slices are not exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segment ordering appears to follow the placement around the circle rather than a clearly consistent sorted-by-size scheme.
